reviews.comment: He is a nice guy, and the class is graded solely based on busy assignments, so it's not a difficult course. The professor is very understanding and will work with you if you need help with assignments and essays. I liked this class, although the lectures were a bit long. I would take him if you need an easy A!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
This class has 4 essays on Peerceptive and a weekly assignment on Perusall where you read ~20 pages and have to evenly distribute 10 comments that are 100+ words for each comment.
In terms of the actual class, attendance is not mandatory, but he teaches stuff that has nothing to do with the assignments. He can be rude but SUPER EASY CLASS!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very kind professor and enthusiastic, however found the lecture content to be a little slow. Not a fan of the tedious 10 comments a week textbook assignments, and found the writing assignments to be graded a bit harsh

Amaral is a wonderful proff! The lectures are detailed, but he provides all the slides, which makes it easy to follow. The workload can be tedious, but it's manageable—mostly Perusall assignments (where you comment while reading an online textbook) and a few essays. I learned a lot from this course and would definitely recommend taking it. Easy A
All quizzes & homework. Chapters are a must-read. Final was difficult, and I actually read the chapters. Interesting content but difficult formatting of class.

Dr. Amaral is a great professor and very sweet! The lectures can be a bit repetitive/not engaging, but you can tell he knows his material. Our section did not have mandatory attendance, but he really appreciated the people that would come to class. Material itself is heavy, but exams and quizzes weren't terribly hard if you actually went to class.

From someone about to Q-drop his class: choose a different professor. He's a nice person, but his exams often ask about things that are never explicitly stated in the slides or textbook, and if you miss class (including being late or leaving early), he takes it *very* personally.

His class is my only one that isn't an A+. Just avoid at all costs.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures may not be the best, but this class is graded on weekly discussion assignments and open-book quizzes & exams. He's accessible to reach out to and assignments were straightforward. It's not too hard to get an A in this class.

Dr. Amaral is a pretty stand up dude. Gives great lectures and is easy to talk to. You would have to try pretty hard to not make an A in this class. Perusall assignments and (open note) exams make your grade.

Grades are made up of Perusall assignments, quizzes, and open note tests. Attendance is not required, but if you don't go to class regularly you might miss some things not on the lecture slides online. The syllabus is clear and the tests are pretty straightforward. Overall, it's not a bad class and it's a pretty easy A.

SOCI 420 was a pretty hard class and the lectures were very confusing, however, for the assignments if you went to class, he would explain them and help you on them. He would also allow you to revise your assignments up to an A. You just have to attend class and pay attention, though it can be confusing, it is doable.

Professor Amaral was an okay professor. His assignments were difficult and it was hard to follow along in class. He went kind of fast when explaining the coding part. The rubric for the assignments wasn't very clear but the TA was helpful. You are allowed corrections on the assignments. 3 assignments + 20 quizzes and a final exam.

Dr. Amaral's class is difficult but If you work hard and attend office hours, he will give you the chance to succeed. I did not have any background knowledge of demographics before this course, which made it very difficult.. but Dr. Amaral was accommodating and patient with me throughout the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are not proficient in population demographics, DO NOT TAKE! This class had grad and undergrad students and there for, Dr. Amaral made everything hard to accommodate to the grad students. He lectures over the class time. Only 4 assignments (that are super hard and lengthy) and a final. He is available for help but does not explain clearly
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard to reach outside of class, very unresponsive to emails. A bad lecturer overall and honestly just unclear with his content. He also does not make it clear what he's asking for in assignments and it makes it that much harder to do well. Class was three coding assignments, 20 quizzes, and a final, and there's corrections for the assignments.

Only 4 exams and 20 quizzes, so very straightforward. You're allowed to use the slides on the quizzes/exams, and all the questions are pretty much directly from them. The material isn't always super interesting which is why I think he gets a bad rep, but he's super passionate about it. Overall good prof.

Lectures can be heavy and hard to pay attention to when he cites many outside examples but tests and quizzes are mostly straightforward. You have to take good notes in this class. He offers extra credit through extra points on writing assignments so don't miss out on those.

3 Exams, 1 Final, but not cumulative 20 Quizzes, 2 questions each, 1 pt total 10 Extra Credit points, a letter grade boost Class is not difficult, but you must pay attention to lectures, which are available on YouTube if unable to attend class zoom Office Hours and responds to emails

Ernesto is definitely a mixed bag. He feels its his responsibility to grade harshly and is loath to hand out extra credit/curve grades. (Class act. For the First test was a 60) looked like he was pressured to curve the grades pretty hard by the department. Class was pretty straightforward until he added in his own convoluted questions. GPA risk.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He cares a lot about his work and also that you learn from his class.

While it is obvious he cares about his subject and is very knowledgeable, it is very easy to fall asleep in his lectures. Offered huge amounts of extra credit to help his grade distribution because test scores were so low. No study guides and all grades are exams. Passive aggressive when students don't immediately get the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A lot of students gave him trash but he really isn't that bad. Exams and lecture are straight off the book, so focus on the objectives. Go to his office hours, I cannot stress this enough! He is SUPER helpful when it comes to assignments. And you can resubmit an assignment for a better grade. He gave extra credit. Be prepared to write!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Amaral is passionate about his field however he does not specify his expectations very clearly. His class was very difficult and the papers were very time consuming. It is possible to do well in his class but you have to be prepared to put A LOT of time into it. He would change requirements right before due dates so it made assignments hard.
Awful teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He is not a good overall. Granted this was hist first semester at TAMU he gave grades back very very slow. We took an exam and a month later he gave us the grade back. He is not very specific with what he wants and he often changes his mind about how he wants things. This class was very stressful. I did well in 220 but I had to drop this class.
